title: Patch: the Fleet track, a Stinkyscape cosmetic track: Starship hull designs, liveries and launch trails earned by playing the set, with a Jlorious Starship gated like the Jlorious card back
notes: How Starships and the board look, and a cosmetic track of their own; nothing plays differently.

player.title: The Fleet track
changes: The Fleet track: 30 levels earned in ladder, unranked and Conquest games for each Stinkyscape card you play, Starship Piece you fuse and Starship you launch, up to a daily limit.
A win with a deck at least half Stinkyscape earns more.
Every level pays a Stinkyscape cosmetic earned only there: hull designs, liveries, engine trails, module skins, a card back, a playmat and a backdrop.
Level 30 pays the Stinkyscape hull, a flagship.
A new Starship tab in the Collection picks the hull, livery, trail and module skin every Starship you launch wears, and your opponent sees them.
Reaching Jlorious now also earns the Jlorious Starship, and everyone who has already reached Jlorious has it.
